instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Titan is a freight forwarding and customs brokerage firm managing sea, air, and road shipments for 200+ SME importers and exporters. They process approximately 300 customs declarations monthly across complex international trade lanes. The company is currently focused on implementing automated document classification and real-time regulatory change monitoring across their top 15 trade corridors to enhance compliance speed.
answers.pastInitiatives: Titan operates an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive six months of funded incubation with dedicated resources, resulting in a portfolio that includes route optimization software and the development of a prototype blockchain solution for secure customs documentation.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter their core market within the next 12 months. They have a tight 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through superior operational efficiency and service differentiation, focusing on predictive risk modeling rather than simple price competition.
answers.additionalContext: The current primary pain point is the manual reconciliation of disparate ERP and TMS systems, leading to significant latency in tariff application. The team lacks specialized data science talent needed for sophisticated predictive modeling.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Tariff & Compliance Engine (Operational Efficiency)
opportunities.rationale: Implement a mature AI/ML engine to automate the classification of complex customs documents and proactively monitor regulatory changes across 15 corridors. This leverages current digital maturity while significantly reducing human error and processing time.

first_actions: Pilot an NLP model for document classification on 20% of monthly declarations
Integrate the pilot engine with existing TMS platform APIs
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average declaration processing time by 30% within Q3
milestones: Q3: Full operational integration and performance monitoring

opportunities.title: Predictive Route Optimization Platform (Market Defense)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical, proprietary predictive logistics platform that moves beyond simple static routing to dynamically predict supply chain disruptions (weather, political instability) and automatically propose optimal contingency routes. This creates a significant competitive moat.

first_actions: Acquire or hire one specialized optimization engineer
Allocate 15% of senior dev time to core platform prototyping
resources_needed: Increased R&D budget allocation (requires board approval)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% reduction in average delivery lead time through predictive modeling within 9 months
milestones: Q3: Beta release to top 5 SME clients for validation
Q4: Full commercial rollout of the platform feature set

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Platform Defense' task force and secure initial funding for the Predictive Route Optimization prototype.
Standardize the data governance process to reduce cross-system integration friction, mitigating a key barrier for both initiatives.
Launch a focused talent search campaign targeting specialized logistics optimization engineers.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on single owner/senior engineer for innovation allocation, leading to resource depletion risk.
Current budget of 9% is insufficient for high-complexity radical development and necessary specialized talent acquisition.
Integration between existing digital tools remains ad-hoc, creating technical debt that hinders scaling automation.
